Lore database for Mibera NFTs. Query and browse 10,000 digital identities across 7 dimensions (archetype, ancestor, element, tarot, era, molecule, swag rank). Cross-reference trait connections and look up canonical data. Ships an MCP server (stdio) for narrative-bot consumers — anti-hallucination lookup for zones, archetypes, factors, grails, and miberas with fuzzy validation + coverage-gap logging.
